objects.name: bits
objects.doc: LSB-first list of up to 16 binary pins.

objects.name: gate
objects.doc: A typed Boolean gate with earlier wire indices.

objects.name: ports
objects.doc: One to sixteen output wire indices.

objects.name: circuit
objects.doc: Validated AND/NOT DAG with at most 16 input pins, 1024 gates and 16 output pins.

objects.name: tuple
objects.doc: Generic finite immutable sequence of structural fields.

objects.name: witness
objects.doc: First lexicographic output-vector difference or None.

objects.name: str
objects.doc: Generic small value used by DAG control flow.

objects.name: bool
objects.doc: Generic small value used by DAG control flow.

operations.name: and_gate
operations.rule: Append one AND gate referencing only earlier typed wires in the same DAG.

operations.name: not_gate
operations.rule: Append one NOT gate referencing only an earlier typed wire in the same DAG.

operations.name: and2
operations.rule: One AND gate with two binary input pins.

operations.name: eval_bits
operations.rule: Validate the DAG and bit arity, evaluate AND/NOT gates in topological order, return all outputs.

operations.name: out_pin
operations.rule: Reveal only the selected output pin after validating the full DAG and complete input.

operations.name: tuple_tail
operations.rule: Return the tail of a nonempty tuple.

operations.name: append_bit
operations.rule: Append a typed bit to a tuple.

operations.name: eq_bit
operations.rule: Compare an output bit with a literal integer bit.

operations.name: eq
operations.rule: Generic integer equality used by bounded equations.
